criteria.description: A default call (no options) still produces the v1 line id|name.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: Every call that does not explicitly ask for a newer version MUST keep producing v1. This includes `exportRecord(record)` and `exportRecord(record, {})`.

criteria.description: An explicit formatVersion: 1 behaves exactly like the default.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: An explicit `formatVersion: 1` must behave exactly like the default.

criteria.description: formatVersion: 2 with a note produces the three-field line id|name|note.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: Only when `options.formatVersion === 2`. When the record has no `note`, the trailing field is empty

criteria.description: formatVersion: 2 without a note still emits three fields (trailing empty field).
criteria.sourceExcerpt: When the record has no `note`, the trailing field is empty (the line still has three fields, ending with `|`).

criteria.description: Existing pipe escaping is preserved in every field, including note.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: In every exported field, a literal `|` is escaped as `\|` ... applies equally to `note`.
